summary.text: Tony McCombie is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 89, in office since 2017, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was elected House Minority Leader for the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Tony McCombie was born and lives in Savanna, Illinois.
Her career experience includes operating Blue Appraisals and working as a real estate broker with MelFoster Company, and she served as mayor and as a city councilwoman of Savanna.
McCombie has held a seat in the Illinois House since 2017, and Ballotpedia says she was elected to serve as House Minority Leader for the 2023-2024 session.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
